title: Collab P2: awareness — presence, live cursors, selection, scene/frame, tool (TTL via awareness)
description: Depends on Collab P1. Use y-protocols/awareness (bundled with y-webrtc). Local awareness state populated from uiStore (which already has the fields): user {id,name,color}; cursor {x,y} (stage coords from uiStore.cursorPos); scene (activeSceneIndex); frame (currentFrame); editContext (document vs symbol-edit); selection (selectedShapeIds + selectedInstanceId); tool (toolState.activeTool). Subscribe uiStore -> awareness.setLocalStateField; subscribe awareness.on('change') -> render remote cursors + selection highlights on the stage and presence avatars in the UI. TTL = the awareness protocol's built-in disconnect timeout (configurable; no custom drop logic). Add genuinely-useful extras: follow-a-peer (jump to their scene/frame), remote-selection outline (per-user color), and an 'editing this symbol' indicator in the Library; for asClasses Y.Text, show remote code-edit cursors if practical. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixtures acceptable); tests for awareness state mapping + remote-cursor render + TTL drop. Update docs/37-collab.md. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Conflict hotspots: uiStore, Shell, StageArea (remote cursor overlay). Sequential after P1.
